name: Little Tree | 200mg Gummies | Pineapple
description:
4 Gummies | 50MG Each | Distillate

Our Pineapple Distillate Gummies offer a smooth, tropical twist on a classic edible. Infused with 50MG of premium cannabis distillate per gummy, each bite brings reliable potency and a laid-back, lasting effect.

With a golden pineapple flavor and a familiar chew, this gummy is perfect for poolside lounging or sunny state-of-mind moments.

Whether you're chasing the sun or just slowing down—this gummy brings the vacation to you.
